details: Renewed geopolitical tensions, particularly those related to the Strait of Hormuz and U.S.-Iran economic measures, have pushed Brent crude oil prices above $95 per barrel and the U.S. 10-year Treasury yield to nearly 4.8%. This surge in energy prices and bond yields is intensifying inflation concerns and increasing expectations for another U.S. Federal Reserve interest rate hike in September. The difficult macro backdrop has led to Bitcoin consolidating around $78K after recent gains, and a significant crypto liquidation wave, wiping out over $369 million in leveraged positions for assets like XRP, Ethereum, and Solana.
sourceUrl: No direct Reuters article from the search results that meets the criteria. The information is aggregated from multiple reports referencing Reuters.
title: Geopolitical Tensions Drive Oil Prices & Fed Rate Hike Bets, Impacting Crypto

details: The U.S. Senate is set to vote on the CLARITY Act around September 15, a pivotal piece of legislation for the cryptocurrency market. This act aims to establish legal definitions for digital assets and create a unified regulatory framework, potentially providing much-needed clarity for the industry. While its passage could foster institutional adoption and a more stable environment, failure to pass would perpetuate regulatory uncertainty.
sourceName: Bitcoin Foundation / TOKENWIRE (as the most direct, non-paywalled sources found)
title: US Senate to Vote on CLARITY Act, Shaping Crypto's Regulatory Future

details: Singapore and Thailand held their first Leaders' Retreat, agreeing to expand cooperation in green and digital economies, artificial intelligence, and energy resilience. Notably, they committed to strengthening regional financial connectivity, including the PromptPay – PayNow cross-border payment link, and enhancing cooperation in combating transnational crime, with particular attention to financial crimes and digital assets.
title: Singapore and Thailand Deepen Digital Economy & Anti-Crime Cooperation
